dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: Low-contrast, thin pale-gray margins with soft boundary sharpness along the distal edges of the folded primaries.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: Seamless transition with no visible color or texture demarcation line separating the head from the upper back.

other_distinctive_markers: Distinctive red fleshy frontal shield on the forehead and high-contrast, large white ovoid spots on a black background on the visible rectrices/undertail coverts.
